name: Sunyata CCG
detailed_description:
Humanity survived the introduction of magic, barely. Now, the world is divided by nations wielding their own magic specialties. In the frozen expanse of Antarctica, mages mold ice into bodies for spirits to inhabit. Riders of Pompeii harness fire to command dragons and carve paths of destruction. Deep within enchanted forests, fairies use nature magic to evolve towering, sentient trees. Even technology has fused with magic, innovating mechs, twisted lab experiments, and human “enhancements.” Otherworldly beasts, demons, and spirits, drawn to the surge of magic, have crossed over into our world.

Our unique mana system lets you customize your abilities every game - each turn, four support cards are generated and you choose two. These cards not only determine your mana resources but also grant powerful player abilities.

In Sunyata, build your deck by mastering a single magic type, or combine elements to craft a strategy uniquely your own.

Each mana type offers unique strengths that cater to different playstyles.

Unleash water mana with rush decks that flood the field with swarming crabs or control the battlefield with earth-shaking mechs by fusing electricity and steel mana. Experiment with combo, mill, and trap strategies, or mix mana types to discover hidden synergies.

For a fresh challenge, try our draft mode, where players build decks from randomly generated packs.

Immerse yourself in the world of Sunyata, where original characters and a rich storyline await. Uncover the history of magic’s arrival and the conflicts it sparked through the lore hidden in card flavor text.

Explore the minds of our unique characters and discover how their life philosophies drive their actions.

Each card is designed with abilities that reflect the character’s traits and magical powers.

Unleash the full potential of your creatures with interactive abilities: Clickable buttons summon token creatures or cast spells; targeted abilities launch fireballs or toss enchanted fruit to boost allies; and equipable abilities add weapons, enhancements, or even dragon riders to unlock powerful synergies.

Wield powerful spells in a unique mage level system. Choose between standard spells with traditional mana costs or unlock potent, efficient spells with high level mages.

Master the art of evolution with our all-new mechanic. Choose to strengthen your creature or deviate its evolution into something entirely different.

Sunyata is free to download and play, offering full access to all cards through in-game progress. Our rewarding system ensures that both free and paying players can explore countless deck types and strategies. Every player starts with eight free decks, unlockable in single-player mode, and can earn booster packs through game play rewards in both ranked and draft mode, totaling over 400 playable cards!

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: N/A
